<thought>The mass spectrum shows a monoisotopic peak at m/z 114.06808 with an M+1 peak at 115.0715 of ~6.7 % intensity, which matches the expected 13C contribution for a molecule containing six carbons. The exact monoisotopic mass 114.06808 corresponds to the formula C₆H₁₀O₂ (C = 72.0000, H = 10 × 1.007825 = 10.07825, O = 2 × 15.994915 = 31.98983; total = 114.06808). Therefore the chemical formula is C6H10O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H10O2</final_answer>
